subject: Possible to use a filtered dataTableOutput as a new object?

messages.author: 559788c27381a3f3
messages.subject: Possible to use a filtered dataTableOutput as a new object?
parts: I like the way shiny shows (and lets the user filter) datatables (using renderDataTable() in the server side and dataTableOutput in the ui side). I was wondering if it ist possible to use a filtered dataTableOutput as a new object I can base e.g. new plots and calculation on in the shiny app?

messages.author: 559788c27381a3f3
messages.subject: Re: Possible to use a filtered dataTableOutput as a new object?
parts: to make my question more clear: I would like to be able to use the filters as selection wizards. Is this possible (though I guess not :-))?
